progressBefore.bodyText: Progress Skin changes slowly. That’s normal. Most actives take 8-12 weeks to show. The mirror hides that. A weekly photo doesn’t. It’s how you’ll see the change, and the reason not to quit early. week 1 week 6 week 12 Guided, on your phone, and never scored. Take my first photo Today Progress Shelf You
